dedupe_keys.name: us ccgt operational benchmark measured efficiency co2 intensity and utilisation of 409 combined cycle plants

description: The US CCGT Operational Benchmark gives one row per EIA plant code for 409 US combined-cycle gas plants, joining measured annual performance to fleet structure. It was released in August 2026 by Dmytro Aheiev of Inzonex, with version 1.1.0 on Zenodo in September 2026. Measured values from US EPA eGRID2022 (CEMS and metered data) include net thermal efficiency (median 46.2 percent, range 22.4 to 65.4 percent), heat rate, CO2 output rate, capacity factor and net generation; structure from EIA Form 860 includes capacity, commissioning year, heat recovery steam generator and gas turbine counts, duct burners, bypass capability, CHP and carbon capture flags, planned retirement, owner and location. The repository adds a data dictionary, three machine learning task definitions, and a join verification table that removed 21 mismatched records. Coverage is the US combined-cycle fleet. The data are a CSV of 409 rows and 30 columns, downloadable from GitHub and Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: values are annual for 2022 only, and it is a one-author derivative of federal data. Simulation uses are calibrating gas plant efficiency and utilisation in capacity expansion models. Related records: data-open-grid-emissions and data-pudl also build on EIA and EPA data.
name: US CCGT Operational Benchmark - measured efficiency, CO2 intensity and utilisation of 409 combined-cycle plants
